verses.text: Remember, Yahweh, what has come on us. Look, and see our reproach.
lines: Remember, Yahweh, what has come on us.
Look, and see our reproach.

verses.text: Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers, our houses to aliens.
lines: Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers,
our houses to aliens.

verses.text: We are orphans and fatherless. Our mothers are as widows.
lines: We are orphans and fatherless.
Our mothers are as widows.

verses.text: We have drunken our water for money. Our wood is sold to us.
lines: We have drunken our water for money.
Our wood is sold to us.

verses.text: Our pursuers are on our necks. We are weary, and have no rest.
lines: Our pursuers are on our necks.
We are weary, and have no rest.

verses.text: We have given our hands to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.
lines: We have given our hands to the Egyptians,
and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.

verses.text: Our fathers sinned, and are no more. We have borne their iniquities.
lines: Our fathers sinned, and are no more.
We have borne their iniquities.

verses.text: Servants rule over us. There is no one to deliver us out of their hand.
lines: Servants rule over us.
There is no one to deliver us out of their hand.

verses.text: We get our bread at the peril of our lives, because of the sword of the wilderness.
lines: We get our bread at the peril of our lives,
because of the sword of the wilderness.

verses.text: Our skin is black like an oven, because of the burning heat of famine.
lines: Our skin is black like an oven,
because of the burning heat of famine.

verses.text: They ravished the women in Zion, the virgins in the cities of Judah.
lines: They ravished the women in Zion,
the virgins in the cities of Judah.

verses.text: Princes were hanged up by their hands. The faces of elders were not honored.
lines: Princes were hanged up by their hands.
The faces of elders were not honored.

verses.text: The young men carry millstones. The children stumbled under loads of wood.
lines: The young men carry millstones.
The children stumbled under loads of wood.

verses.text: The elders have ceased from the gate, and the young men from their music.
lines: The elders have ceased from the gate,
and the young men from their music.

verses.text: The joy of our heart has ceased. Our dance is turned into mourning.
lines: The joy of our heart has ceased.
Our dance is turned into mourning.

verses.text: The crown has fallen from our head. Woe to us, for we have sinned!
lines: The crown has fallen from our head.
Woe to us, for we have sinned!

verses.text: For this our heart is faint. For these things our eyes are dim.
lines: For this our heart is faint.
For these things our eyes are dim.

verses.text: For the mountain of Zion, which is desolate. The foxes walk on it.
lines: For the mountain of Zion, which is desolate.
The foxes walk on it.

verses.text: You, Yahweh, remain forever. Your throne is from generation to generation.
lines: You, Yahweh, remain forever.
Your throne is from generation to generation.

verses.text: Why do you forget us forever, and forsake us for so long a time?
lines: Why do you forget us forever,
and forsake us for so long a time?

verses.text: Turn us to yourself, Yahweh, and we will be turned. Renew our days as of old.
lines: Turn us to yourself, Yahweh, and we will be turned.
Renew our days as of old.

verses.text: But you have utterly rejected us. You are very angry against us.
lines: But you have utterly rejected us.
You are very angry against us.
